# Competitor basket specification

Status: research template; no matched-price study is claimed complete.

Create a representative basket with buyer evidence rather than selecting only products where our purchase cost looks favourable. Compare Praxisdienst and relevant UK broad/specialist sellers against the same delivery postcode and buyer/tax status.

## Candidate basket slots

| Slot | Product specification to fix before price collection |
|---|---|
| 01 | Nitrile examination glove, exact brand/model, size, colour and box count |
| 02 | Face mask or respirator, exact protective/medical specification and pack |
| 03 | Couch roll, width, length, ply, roll count and case |
| 04 | Gauze swab, size, ply, sterile status and quantity |
| 05 | Adhesive dressing, exact model/size and pack |
| 06 | Syringe, volume, connector, sterile status and pack |
| 07 | Needle, gauge/length, safety mechanism and pack |
| 08 | Blood collection tube, manufacturer/additive/draw volume and pack |
| 09 | Device/surface wipe, exact intended use, formulation and count |
| 10 | Hand product, exact formula, bottle size and authorisation route |
| 11 | Ear specula, brand/compatible model, size and count |
| 12 | Stethoscope, exact model/colour and warranty |
| 13 | BP monitor, model, cuff and power accessories |
| 14 | Thermometer, model and included consumables |
| 15 | Pulse oximeter, model and intended use |
| 16 | Diagnostic strip/test, exact product, intended user, pack and shelf life |
| 17 | AED pad set, compatible model and minimum expiry |
| 18 | Sharps container, capacity, lid/use type and pack |
| 19 | Sterilisation pouch/indicator, exact size/use and count |
| 20 | Instrument, manufacturer/model, reusable/sterile status and quantity |
| 21 | Saddle stool, model, backrest, colour, load and assembly |
| 22 | Examination couch, model, width, lift, delivery and installation |
| 23 | Medical scale, exact intended use, capacity and verification/service |
| 24 | Dental consumable, exact material/model and pack |
| 25 | Veterinary consumable, exact intended use and pack |
| 26 | Continence product, size/absorbency and count |
| 27 | Workwear, model, fabric, size and return conditions |
| 28 | Lab item, clinical/research use and exact model/pack |
| 29 | Authorised medicine comparison, only within an approved supply route |
| 30 | Temperature/service-sensitive product, exact lane and conditions |

The slots are not a purchase recommendation or assertion of customer demand. Replace them with actual interview baskets when available.

## Record for every observation

Date/time, source URL, destination, logged-in status, buyer type, currency/FX, manufacturer and exact MPN/GTIN, pack quantity, net price, VAT, gross price, mandatory fees, freight, delivery/stock, minimum shelf life, warranty and promotion conditions. Record unavailable quotes as unavailable rather than zero.

Calculate comparable unit cost and delivered basket cost. Use exact-match, materially different and unavailable labels; do not score a substitute as identical. Separate consumer/public prices from contract quotes. No medical equivalence should be inferred from a similar description.
